classes.title: Controlled stop
classes.expected_io_behavior: Software safe-state executes and drives critical outputs into configured safe values.

expected_outputs.description: Vertical brake coil (NC): 0 means brake engaged.

classes.title: Recoverable runtime exception
classes.expected_io_behavior: Fault handling path completes and safe-state output profile is applied.

classes.title: Process crash / abort
classes.expected_io_behavior: Software cleanup is best-effort only; hardware safety chain still de-energizes critical actuators.

expected_outputs.description: Brake coil is de-energized by safety chain.
Enable is de-energized by safety chain.

classes.title: Uncontrollable termination
classes.expected_io_behavior: No software callback is guaranteed; safety depends entirely on independent hardware safety chain.

expected_outputs.description: Brake channel must be safe with power/process loss.
Enable channel must drop without PLC cooperation.

electrical_checklist_notes: Verify vertical brake coil (do2) de-energizes before or at the same instant as axis enable (do1) for controlled fault paths.
For process abort/power-loss conditions, confirm independent safety relay/STO path drops both do2 and do1 without software callbacks.
Capture measured channel waveform timestamps and attach them to class-D evidence artifacts.
